name: Spiced Veggie, Lentil & Chickpea Soup (Harira) with Cilantro Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Rinse chickpeas and lentils in a colander or strainer; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
1 ½ cups brown lentils, dried

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with onion and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, carrot, celery, spices, and sugar to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies soften, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Add chickpeas, lentils, broth, and tomatoes to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the soup comes to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into the reserved bowl; add water, flour, and eggs. Whisk to combine the thickening liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup water
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
3 eggs

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the thickening liquid and whisk to combine; set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for the next step.)
Place remaining cilantro in a small bowl. Add yogurt and water; stir to combine the cilantro yogurt and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp water

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are tender, slowly pour the thickening liquid into the soup while gently stirring. Simmer until soup thickens, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with cilantro yogurt. Enjoy!
